# Sunset Peak Lodge

## Hotel Overview
Sunset Peak Lodge is located in Phoenix, AZ, USA. Luxury accommodations with stunning city views

**Guest Rating:** 4.5/5.0
**Total Rooms:** 290

## Contact Information
**Address:** 1052 Central Avenue, Phoenix, AZ 85002
**Phone:** +1-602-555-0128
**Email:** phoenix2@anycompany.com

## Check-in & Check-out

### Check-in Time
Standard check-in time is 3:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to availability and may be requested at the time of booking or by contacting the hotel directly.

### Check-out Time
Standard check-out time is 11:00 AM. Late check-out until 2:00 PM may be available for an additional fee of $50, subject to availability.

### Express Check-out
Express check-out is available. Guests can review and approve their bill the night before departure and simply drop off their room keys at the front desk or in the express check-out box.

## Reservations & Cancellations

### Making a Reservation
Reservations can be made through:
- Our website: www.anycompany.com
- Phone: +1-602-555-0128
- Email: phoenix2@anycompany.com
- Mobile app: AnyCompany Hotels

### Cancellation Policy
Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours prior to arrival to avoid a one-night room charge. Cancellations for group bookings (10+ rooms) require 72 hours notice.

### Modification Policy
Reservations can be modified up to 24 hours before arrival at no charge. Changes to dates are subject to availability and rate differences may apply.

### Deposit Requirements
A valid credit card is required at the time of booking. A deposit equal to one night's room rate plus tax will be charged at booking for reservations made within 7 days of arrival.

### Payment Methods
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and Diners Club. Cash and debit cards are also accepted.

## Room Information

### Room Types Available
- **Standard Room:** Comfortable accommodations with essential amenities ($200-350 per night)
- **Deluxe Room:** Enhanced space and upgraded amenities ($350-500 per night)
- **Suite:** Spacious suite with separate living area ($550-900 per night)

### Bed Configurations
- King bed
- Two Queen beds
- Accessible rooms with King bed

### Maximum Occupancy
- Standard/Deluxe Rooms: Up to 4 guests
- Suites: Up to 6 guests

### In-Room Amenities
All rooms include:
- Complimentary high-speed WiFi
- Flat-screen TV with premium channels
- Coffee maker with complimentary coffee and tea
- Mini-refrigerator
- In-room safe
- Iron and ironing board
- Hair dryer
- Complimentary toiletries
- Climate control

### Accessibility Features
Accessible rooms are available featuring:
- Roll-in showers or accessible tubs
- Grab bars
- Lowered fixtures
- Visual alert systems
- Accessible door hardware

## Hotel Amenities

- Outdoor Swimming Pool
- Full-Service Spa
- 24-Hour Fitness Center
- Complimentary High-Speed Wifi
- On-Site Restaurant
- Lounge Bar

### Pool
Our outdoor pool is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Pool towels are provided.

### Fitness Center
Our 24-hour fitness center is equipped with cardio machines, free weights, and strength training equipment.

### Restaurant & Bar
Our on-site restaurant serves breakfast (6:30 AM - 10:30 AM), lunch (11:30 AM - 2:30 PM), and dinner (5:30 PM - 10:00 PM). The bar is open from 4:00 PM to midnight.

### Business Center
Business center facilities are not available at this property.

### Parking
Parking is available for $15 per night. Self-parking is available in our parking facility.

### Pet Policy
Pets are welcome! We charge a non-refundable pet fee of $50 per stay. Maximum of 2 pets per room, with a weight limit of 50 lbs per pet. Service animals are always welcome at no charge.

## Pricing & Fees

### Room Rates
Room rates vary by season and availability:
- Standard Room: $200-350 per night
- Deluxe Room: $350-500 per night
- Suite: $550-900 per night

Rates are subject to change and do not include taxes and fees.

### Resort Fees
A resort fee of $35 per night per night applies and includes WiFi, fitness center access, and pool access.

### Parking Fees
$15 per night

### Pet Fees
$50 per stay (non-refundable)

### Extra Guest Charges
Additional guests beyond standard occupancy: $25 per person per night (children under 12 stay free)

## Location & Transportation

### Address & Directions
1052 Central Avenue, Phoenix, AZ 85002

### Airport Transportation
Airport shuttle service is not provided. Taxi and rideshare services are readily available.

### Public Transportation
The hotel is conveniently located near public transportation options. Please contact the front desk for detailed directions and schedules.

### Nearby Attractions
Luxury accommodations with stunning city views Our concierge can provide recommendations and assistance with booking local tours and attractions.

## Services

### Room Service
Room service is not available. However, many delivery options are available in the area.

### Housekeeping
Daily housekeeping service is provided. Additional cleaning services can be requested at the front desk.

### Laundry Services
Laundry services can be arranged through the front desk with local providers.

### Concierge Services
Front desk staff are happy to provide local recommendations and assistance.

### Wake-up Calls
Automated wake-up calls can be arranged through your in-room phone or by contacting the front desk.

## Policies

### Smoking Policy
Sunset Peak Lodge is a non-smoking property. Smoking is permitted in designated outdoor areas only. A cleaning fee of $250 applies to any smoking in guest rooms.

### Age Requirements
Guests must be at least 18 years of age to check in.

### ID Requirements
A valid government-issued photo ID and credit card are required at check-in.

### Damage Policy
Guests are responsible for any damage to hotel property. Charges for damages will be applied to the credit card on file.

### Quiet Hours
Quiet hours are observed from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. We ask all guests to be respectful of others during these hours.

## WiFi & Technology

### WiFi Availability
Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms and public areas.

### Network Access
Network name and password are provided at check-in and are also available in your guest room.

### Smart TV
All rooms feature smart TVs with access to premium channels and streaming capabilities.

### Charging Ports
Rooms are equipped with USB charging ports and standard electrical outlets.

## Special Requests

### Cribs & Rollaway Beds
Cribs are available at no charge (subject to availability). Rollaway beds are available for $25 per night.

### Connecting Rooms
Connecting rooms are available and can be requested at the time of booking (subject to availability).

### Floor Preferences
High floor and low floor preferences can be requested but cannot be guaranteed. We will do our best to accommodate your preference.

### Hypoallergenic Rooms
Hypoallergenic rooms with special cleaning protocols are available upon request. Please notify us at the time of booking.

## Additional Information

For any questions or special requests, please contact us at:
- Phone: +1-602-555-0128
- Email: phoenix2@anycompany.com

We look forward to welcoming you to Sunset Peak Lodge!

1. **Sunset Peak Lodge** – Phoenix, AZ, USA
2. **Ceramic Tile Grand Hotel** – Puebla, Puebla, Mexico
3. **Blowhole Coastal Resort** – Ensenada, Baja California, Mexico

All three list "Outdoor Swimming Pool" among their amenities, with the pool open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM and pool towels provided. Pool access is also included in their nightly resort fee ($35/night).

**Note:** My search tool retrieves results based on relevance matching rather than performing an exact database count. Since I don't have access to query the complete hotel database directly, there may be additional hotels with pools that weren't captured in this search. If you need an exact, complete count, I'd recommend checking directly with the reservations system or letting me know if you'd like me to search using different terms to try to surface additional matches.

trials.system_prompt: You are a travel agent. Use the knowledge base to answer questions accurately. You can run multiple queries.
trials.question: How many hotels in the database have a swimming pool?

retrieval.cypher: MATCH (h:Hotel)-[:HAS_AMENITY]->(a:Amenity) WHERE toLower(a.name) CONTAINS 'pool' RETURN count(DISTINCT h) AS hotelCount
CALL db.relationshipTypes() YIELD relationshipType RETURN relationshipType
MATCH (h:Hotel)-[:OFFERS_AMENITY]->(a) WHERE toLower(a.name) CONTAINS 'pool' RETURN h.name AS hotelName, a.name AS amenity

# Sunset Peak Lodge

## Hotel Overview
Sunset Peak Lodge is located in Phoenix, AZ, USA. Luxury accommodations with stunning city views

**Guest Rating:** 4.5/5.0
**Total Rooms:** 290

## Contact Information
**Address:** 1052 Central Avenue, Phoenix, AZ 85002
**Phone:** +1-602-555-0128
**Email:** phoenix2@anycompany.com

## Check-in & Check-out

### Check-in Time
Standard check-in time is 3:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to availability and may be requested at the time of booking or by contacting the hotel directly.

### Check-out Time
Standard check-out time is 11:00 AM. Late check-out until 2:00 PM may be available for an additional fee of $50, subject to availability.

### Express Check-out
Express check-out is available. Guests can review and approve their bill the night before departure and simply drop off their room keys at the front desk or in the express check-out box.

## Reservations & Cancellations

### Making a Reservation
Reservations can be made through:
- Our website: www.anycompany.com
- Phone: +1-602-555-0128
- Email: phoenix2@anycompany.com
- Mobile app: AnyCompany Hotels

### Cancellation Policy
Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours prior to arrival to avoid a one-night room charge. Cancellations for group bookings (10+ rooms) require 72 hours notice.

### Modification Policy
Reservations can be modified up to 24 hours before arrival at no charge. Changes to dates are subject to availability and rate differences may apply.

### Deposit Requirements
A valid credit card is required at the time of booking. A deposit equal to one night's room rate plus tax will be charged at booking for reservations made within 7 days of arrival.

### Payment Methods
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and Diners Club. Cash and debit cards are also accepted.

## Room Information

### Room Types Available
- **Standard Room:** Comfortable accommodations with essential amenities ($200-350 per night)
- **Deluxe Room:** Enhanced space and upgraded amenities ($350-500 per night)
- **Suite:** Spacious suite with separate living area ($550-900 per night)

### Bed Configurations
- King bed
- Two Queen beds
- Accessible rooms with King bed

### Maximum Occupancy
- Standard/Deluxe Rooms: Up to 4 guests
- Suites: Up to 6 guests

### In-Room Amenities
All rooms include:
- Complimentary high-speed WiFi
- Flat-screen TV with premium channels
- Coffee maker with complimentary coffee and tea
- Mini-refrigerator
- In-room safe
- Iron and ironing board
- Hair dryer
- Complimentary toiletries
- Climate control

### Accessibility Features
Accessible rooms are available featuring:
- Roll-in showers or accessible tubs
- Grab bars
- Lowered fixtures
- Visual alert systems
- Accessible door hardware

## Hotel Amenities

- Outdoor Swimming Pool
- Full-Service Spa
- 24-Hour Fitness Center
- Complimentary High-Speed Wifi
- On-Site Restaurant
- Lounge Bar

### Pool
Our outdoor pool is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Pool towels are provided.

### Fitness Center
Our 24-hour fitness center is equipped with cardio machines, free weights, and strength training equipment.

### Restaurant & Bar
Our on-site restaurant serves breakfast (6:30 AM - 10:30 AM), lunch (11:30 AM - 2:30 PM), and dinner (5:30 PM - 10:00 PM). The bar is open from 4:00 PM to midnight.

### Business Center
Business center facilities are not available at this property.

### Parking
Parking is available for $15 per night. Self-parking is available in our parking facility.

### Pet Policy
Pets are welcome! We charge a non-refundable pet fee of $50 per stay. Maximum of 2 pets per room, with a weight limit of 50 lbs per pet. Service animals are always welcome at no charge.

## Pricing & Fees

### Room Rates
Room rates vary by season and availability:
- Standard Room: $200-350 per night
- Deluxe Room: $350-500 per night
- Suite: $550-900 per night

Rates are subject to change and do not include taxes and fees.

### Resort Fees
A resort fee of $35 per night per night applies and includes WiFi, fitness center access, and pool access.

### Parking Fees
$15 per night

### Pet Fees
$50 per stay (non-refundable)

### Extra Guest Charges
Additional guests beyond standard occupancy: $25 per person per night (children under 12 stay free)

## Location & Transportation

### Address & Directions
1052 Central Avenue, Phoenix, AZ 85002

### Airport Transportation
Airport shuttle service is not provided. Taxi and rideshare services are readily available.

### Public Transportation
The hotel is conveniently located near public transportation options. Please contact the front desk for detailed directions and schedules.

### Nearby Attractions
Luxury accommodations with stunning city views Our concierge can provide recommendations and assistance with booking local tours and attractions.

## Services

### Room Service
Room service is not available. However, many delivery options are available in the area.

### Housekeeping
Daily housekeeping service is provided. Additional cleaning services can be requested at the front desk.

### Laundry Services
Laundry services can be arranged through the front desk with local providers.

### Concierge Services
Front desk staff are happy to provide local recommendations and assistance.

### Wake-up Calls
Automated wake-up calls can be arranged through your in-room phone or by contacting the front desk.

## Policies

### Smoking Policy
Sunset Peak Lodge is a non-smoking property. Smoking is permitted in designated outdoor areas only. A cleaning fee of $250 applies to any smoking in guest rooms.

### Age Requirements
Guests must be at least 18 years of age to check in.

### ID Requirements
A valid government-issued photo ID and credit card are required at check-in.

### Damage Policy
Guests are responsible for any damage to hotel property. Charges for damages will be applied to the credit card on file.

### Quiet Hours
Quiet hours are observed from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. We ask all guests to be respectful of others during these hours.

## WiFi & Technology

### WiFi Availability
Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms and public areas.

### Network Access
Network name and password are provided at check-in and are also available in your guest room.

### Smart TV
All rooms feature smart TVs with access to premium channels and streaming capabilities.

### Charging Ports
Rooms are equipped with USB charging ports and standard electrical outlets.

## Special Requests

### Cribs & Rollaway Beds
Cribs are available at no charge (subject to availability). Rollaway beds are available for $25 per night.

### Connecting Rooms
Connecting rooms are available and can be requested at the time of booking (subject to availability).

### Floor Preferences
High floor and low floor preferences can be requested but cannot be guaranteed. We will do our best to accommodate your preference.

### Hypoallergenic Rooms
Hypoallergenic rooms with special cleaning protocols are available upon request. Please notify us at the time of booking.

## Additional Information

For any questions or special requests, please contact us at:
- Phone: +1-602-555-0128
- Email: phoenix2@anycompany.com

We look forward to welcoming you to Sunset Peak Lodge!

Airport shuttle service is not provided. Taxi and rideshare services are readily available.

### Public Transportation
The hotel is conveniently located near public transportation options. Please contact the front desk for detailed directions and schedules.

### Nearby Attractions
Contemporary hotel perfect for business and leisure Our concierge can provide recommendations and assistance with booking local tours and attractions.

## Services

### Room Service
Room service is not available. However, many delivery options are available in the area.

### Housekeeping
Daily housekeeping service is provided. Additional cleaning services can be requested at the front desk.

### Laundry Services
Laundry services can be arranged through the front desk with local providers.

### Concierge Services
Our concierge team is available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM to assist with restaurant reservations, tour bookings, and local recommendations.

### Wake-up Calls
Automated wake-up calls can be arranged through your in-room phone or by contacting the front desk.

## Policies

### Smoking Policy
Blowhole Coastal Resort is a non-smoking property. Smoking is permitted in designated outdoor areas only. A cleaning fee of $250 applies to any smoking in guest rooms.

### Age Requirements
Guests must be at least 18 years of age to check in.

### ID Requirements
A valid government-issued photo ID and credit card are required at check-in.

### Damage Policy
Guests are responsible for any damage to hotel property. Charges for damages will be applied to the credit card on file.

### Quiet Hours
Quiet hours are observed from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. We ask all guests to be respectful of others during these hours.

## WiFi & Technology

### WiFi Availability
Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms and public areas.

### Network Access
Network name and password are provided at check-in and are also available in your guest room.

### Smart TV
All rooms feature smart TVs with access to premium channels and streaming capabilities.

### Charging Ports
Rooms are equipped with USB charging ports and standard electrical outlets.

## Special Requests

### Cribs & Rollaway Beds
Cribs are available at no charge (subject to availability). Rollaway beds are available for $25 per night.

### Connecting Rooms
Connecting rooms are available and can be requested at the time of booking (subject to availability).

### Floor Preferences
High floor and low floor preferences can be requested but cannot be guaranteed. We will do our best to accommodate your preference.

### Hypoallergenic Rooms
Hypoallergenic rooms with special cleaning protocols are available upon request. Please notify us at the time of booking.

## Additional Information

For any questions or special requests, please contact us at:
- Phone: +52-646-555-0270
- Email: ensenada2@anycompany.com

MATCH (h:Hotel)-[:OFFERS_AMENITY]->(a:Amenity) WHERE toLower(a.name) CONTAINS 'pool' RETURN count(DISTINCT h) AS hotelsWithPool

# Sunset Peak Lodge

## Hotel Overview
Sunset Peak Lodge is located in Phoenix, AZ, USA. Luxury accommodations with stunning city views

**Guest Rating:** 4.5/5.0
**Total Rooms:** 290

## Contact Information
**Address:** 1052 Central Avenue, Phoenix, AZ 85002
**Phone:** +1-602-555-0128
**Email:** phoenix2@anycompany.com

## Check-in & Check-out

### Check-in Time
Standard check-in time is 3:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to availability and may be requested at the time of booking or by contacting the hotel directly.

### Check-out Time
Standard check-out time is 11:00 AM. Late check-out until 2:00 PM may be available for an additional fee of $50, subject to availability.

### Express Check-out
Express check-out is available. Guests can review and approve their bill the night before departure and simply drop off their room keys at the front desk or in the express check-out box.

## Reservations & Cancellations

### Making a Reservation
Reservations can be made through:
- Our website: www.anycompany.com
- Phone: +1-602-555-0128
- Email: phoenix2@anycompany.com
- Mobile app: AnyCompany Hotels

### Cancellation Policy
Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours prior to arrival to avoid a one-night room charge. Cancellations for group bookings (10+ rooms) require 72 hours notice.

### Modification Policy
Reservations can be modified up to 24 hours before arrival at no charge. Changes to dates are subject to availability and rate differences may apply.

### Deposit Requirements
A valid credit card is required at the time of booking. A deposit equal to one night's room rate plus tax will be charged at booking for reservations made within 7 days of arrival.

### Payment Methods
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and Diners Club. Cash and debit cards are also accepted.

## Room Information

### Room Types Available
- **Standard Room:** Comfortable accommodations with essential amenities ($200-350 per night)
- **Deluxe Room:** Enhanced space and upgraded amenities ($350-500 per night)
- **Suite:** Spacious suite with separate living area ($550-900 per night)

### Bed Configurations
- King bed
- Two Queen beds
- Accessible rooms with King bed

### Maximum Occupancy
- Standard/Deluxe Rooms: Up to 4 guests
- Suites: Up to 6 guests

### In-Room Amenities
All rooms include:
- Complimentary high-speed WiFi
- Flat-screen TV with premium channels
- Coffee maker with complimentary coffee and tea
- Mini-refrigerator
- In-room safe
- Iron and ironing board
- Hair dryer
- Complimentary toiletries
- Climate control

### Accessibility Features
Accessible rooms are available featuring:
- Roll-in showers or accessible tubs
- Grab bars
- Lowered fixtures
- Visual alert systems
- Accessible door hardware

## Hotel Amenities

- Outdoor Swimming Pool
- Full-Service Spa
- 24-Hour Fitness Center
- Complimentary High-Speed Wifi
- On-Site Restaurant
- Lounge Bar

### Pool
Our outdoor pool is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Pool towels are provided.

### Fitness Center
Our 24-hour fitness center is equipped with cardio machines, free weights, and strength training equipment.

### Restaurant & Bar
Our on-site restaurant serves breakfast (6:30 AM - 10:30 AM), lunch (11:30 AM - 2:30 PM), and dinner (5:30 PM - 10:00 PM). The bar is open from 4:00 PM to midnight.

### Business Center
Business center facilities are not available at this property.

### Parking
Parking is available for $15 per night. Self-parking is available in our parking facility.

### Pet Policy
Pets are welcome! We charge a non-refundable pet fee of $50 per stay. Maximum of 2 pets per room, with a weight limit of 50 lbs per pet. Service animals are always welcome at no charge.

## Pricing & Fees

### Room Rates
Room rates vary by season and availability:
- Standard Room: $200-350 per night
- Deluxe Room: $350-500 per night
- Suite: $550-900 per night

Rates are subject to change and do not include taxes and fees.

### Resort Fees
A resort fee of $35 per night per night applies and includes WiFi, fitness center access, and pool access.

### Parking Fees
$15 per night

### Pet Fees
$50 per stay (non-refundable)

### Extra Guest Charges
Additional guests beyond standard occupancy: $25 per person per night (children under 12 stay free)

## Location & Transportation

### Address & Directions
1052 Central Avenue, Phoenix, AZ 85002

### Airport Transportation
Airport shuttle service is not provided. Taxi and rideshare services are readily available.

### Public Transportation
The hotel is conveniently located near public transportation options. Please contact the front desk for detailed directions and schedules.

### Nearby Attractions
Luxury accommodations with stunning city views Our concierge can provide recommendations and assistance with booking local tours and attractions.

## Services

### Room Service
Room service is not available. However, many delivery options are available in the area.

### Housekeeping
Daily housekeeping service is provided. Additional cleaning services can be requested at the front desk.

### Laundry Services
Laundry services can be arranged through the front desk with local providers.

### Concierge Services
Front desk staff are happy to provide local recommendations and assistance.

### Wake-up Calls
Automated wake-up calls can be arranged through your in-room phone or by contacting the front desk.

## Policies

### Smoking Policy
Sunset Peak Lodge is a non-smoking property. Smoking is permitted in designated outdoor areas only. A cleaning fee of $250 applies to any smoking in guest rooms.

### Age Requirements
Guests must be at least 18 years of age to check in.

### ID Requirements
A valid government-issued photo ID and credit card are required at check-in.

### Damage Policy
Guests are responsible for any damage to hotel property. Charges for damages will be applied to the credit card on file.

### Quiet Hours
Quiet hours are observed from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. We ask all guests to be respectful of others during these hours.

## WiFi & Technology

### WiFi Availability
Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms and public areas.

### Network Access
Network name and password are provided at check-in and are also available in your guest room.

### Smart TV
All rooms feature smart TVs with access to premium channels and streaming capabilities.

### Charging Ports
Rooms are equipped with USB charging ports and standard electrical outlets.

## Special Requests

### Cribs & Rollaway Beds
Cribs are available at no charge (subject to availability). Rollaway beds are available for $25 per night.

### Connecting Rooms
Connecting rooms are available and can be requested at the time of booking (subject to availability).

### Floor Preferences
High floor and low floor preferences can be requested but cannot be guaranteed. We will do our best to accommodate your preference.

### Hypoallergenic Rooms
Hypoallergenic rooms with special cleaning protocols are available upon request. Please notify us at the time of booking.

## Additional Information

For any questions or special requests, please contact us at:
- Phone: +1-602-555-0128
- Email: phoenix2@anycompany.com

We look forward to welcoming you to Sunset Peak Lodge!

retrieval.cypher: MATCH (h:Hotel) RETURN keys(h) LIMIT 5
MATCH (h:Hotel)-[:OFFERS_AMENITY]->(a:Amenity) WHERE toLower(a.name) CONTAINS 'pool' RETURN DISTINCT h.name AS hotel, a.name AS amenity
MATCH (a:Amenity) RETURN DISTINCT a.name AS amenity ORDER BY amenity
MATCH (h:Hotel)-[:OFFERS_AMENITY]->(a:Amenity) WHERE toLower(a.name) CONTAINS 'pool' RETURN count(DISTINCT h) AS hotelsWithPool

# Sunset Peak Lodge

## Hotel Overview
Sunset Peak Lodge is located in Phoenix, AZ, USA. Luxury accommodations with stunning city views

**Guest Rating:** 4.5/5.0
**Total Rooms:** 290

## Contact Information
**Address:** 1052 Central Avenue, Phoenix, AZ 85002
**Phone:** +1-602-555-0128
**Email:** phoenix2@anycompany.com

## Check-in & Check-out

### Check-in Time
Standard check-in time is 3:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to availability and may be requested at the time of booking or by contacting the hotel directly.

### Check-out Time
Standard check-out time is 11:00 AM. Late check-out until 2:00 PM may be available for an additional fee of $50, subject to availability.

### Express Check-out
Express check-out is available. Guests can review and approve their bill the night before departure and simply drop off their room keys at the front desk or in the express check-out box.

## Reservations & Cancellations

### Making a Reservation
Reservations can be made through:
- Our website: www.anycompany.com
- Phone: +1-602-555-0128
- Email: phoenix2@anycompany.com
- Mobile app: AnyCompany Hotels

### Cancellation Policy
Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours prior to arrival to avoid a one-night room charge. Cancellations for group bookings (10+ rooms) require 72 hours notice.

### Modification Policy
Reservations can be modified up to 24 hours before arrival at no charge. Changes to dates are subject to availability and rate differences may apply.

### Deposit Requirements
A valid credit card is required at the time of booking. A deposit equal to one night's room rate plus tax will be charged at booking for reservations made within 7 days of arrival.

### Payment Methods
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and Diners Club. Cash and debit cards are also accepted.

## Room Information

### Room Types Available
- **Standard Room:** Comfortable accommodations with essential amenities ($200-350 per night)
- **Deluxe Room:** Enhanced space and upgraded amenities ($350-500 per night)
- **Suite:** Spacious suite with separate living area ($550-900 per night)

### Bed Configurations
- King bed
- Two Queen beds
- Accessible rooms with King bed

### Maximum Occupancy
- Standard/Deluxe Rooms: Up to 4 guests
- Suites: Up to 6 guests

### In-Room Amenities
All rooms include:
- Complimentary high-speed WiFi
- Flat-screen TV with premium channels
- Coffee maker with complimentary coffee and tea
- Mini-refrigerator
- In-room safe
- Iron and ironing board
- Hair dryer
- Complimentary toiletries
- Climate control

### Accessibility Features
Accessible rooms are available featuring:
- Roll-in showers or accessible tubs
- Grab bars
- Lowered fixtures
- Visual alert systems
- Accessible door hardware

## Hotel Amenities

- Outdoor Swimming Pool
- Full-Service Spa
- 24-Hour Fitness Center
- Complimentary High-Speed Wifi
- On-Site Restaurant
- Lounge Bar

### Pool
Our outdoor pool is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Pool towels are provided.

### Fitness Center
Our 24-hour fitness center is equipped with cardio machines, free weights, and strength training equipment.

### Restaurant & Bar
Our on-site restaurant serves breakfast (6:30 AM - 10:30 AM), lunch (11:30 AM - 2:30 PM), and dinner (5:30 PM - 10:00 PM). The bar is open from 4:00 PM to midnight.

### Business Center
Business center facilities are not available at this property.

### Parking
Parking is available for $15 per night. Self-parking is available in our parking facility.

### Pet Policy
Pets are welcome! We charge a non-refundable pet fee of $50 per stay. Maximum of 2 pets per room, with a weight limit of 50 lbs per pet. Service animals are always welcome at no charge.

## Pricing & Fees

### Room Rates
Room rates vary by season and availability:
- Standard Room: $200-350 per night
- Deluxe Room: $350-500 per night
- Suite: $550-900 per night

Rates are subject to change and do not include taxes and fees.

### Resort Fees
A resort fee of $35 per night per night applies and includes WiFi, fitness center access, and pool access.

### Parking Fees
$15 per night

### Pet Fees
$50 per stay (non-refundable)

### Extra Guest Charges
Additional guests beyond standard occupancy: $25 per person per night (children under 12 stay free)

## Location & Transportation

### Address & Directions
1052 Central Avenue, Phoenix, AZ 85002

### Airport Transportation
Airport shuttle service is not provided. Taxi and rideshare services are readily available.

### Public Transportation
The hotel is conveniently located near public transportation options. Please contact the front desk for detailed directions and schedules.

### Nearby Attractions
Luxury accommodations with stunning city views Our concierge can provide recommendations and assistance with booking local tours and attractions.

## Services

### Room Service
Room service is not available. However, many delivery options are available in the area.

### Housekeeping
Daily housekeeping service is provided. Additional cleaning services can be requested at the front desk.

### Laundry Services
Laundry services can be arranged through the front desk with local providers.

### Concierge Services
Front desk staff are happy to provide local recommendations and assistance.

### Wake-up Calls
Automated wake-up calls can be arranged through your in-room phone or by contacting the front desk.

## Policies

### Smoking Policy
Sunset Peak Lodge is a non-smoking property. Smoking is permitted in designated outdoor areas only. A cleaning fee of $250 applies to any smoking in guest rooms.

### Age Requirements
Guests must be at least 18 years of age to check in.

### ID Requirements
A valid government-issued photo ID and credit card are required at check-in.

### Damage Policy
Guests are responsible for any damage to hotel property. Charges for damages will be applied to the credit card on file.

### Quiet Hours
Quiet hours are observed from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. We ask all guests to be respectful of others during these hours.

## WiFi & Technology

### WiFi Availability
Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms and public areas.

### Network Access
Network name and password are provided at check-in and are also available in your guest room.

### Smart TV
All rooms feature smart TVs with access to premium channels and streaming capabilities.

### Bed Configurations
- King bed
- Two Queen beds
- Accessible rooms with King bed

- Hair dryer

- Grab bars

- Visual alert systems
- Accessible door hardware

- Outdoor Swimming Pool
- Full-Service Spa
- 24-Hour Fitness Center
- Complimentary High-Speed Wifi
- On-Site Restaurant
- Lounge Bar

### Pool
Our outdoor pool is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Pool towels are provided.

### Fitness Center
Our 24-hour fitness center is equipped with cardio machines, free weights, and strength training equipment.

### Restaurant & Bar
Our on-site restaurant serves breakfast (6:30 AM - 10:30 AM), lunch (11:30 AM - 2:30 PM), and dinner (5:30 PM - 10:00 PM). The bar is open from 4:00 PM to midnight.

### Business Center
Business center facilities are not available at this property.

### Parking
Parking is available for $15 per night. Self-parking is available in our parking facility.

### Pet Policy
Pets are welcome! We charge a non-refundable pet fee of $50 per stay. Maximum of 2 pets per room, with a weight limit of 50 lbs per pet. Service animals are always welcome at no charge.

## Pricing & Fees

### Room Rates
Room rates vary by season and availability:
- Standard Room: $200-350 per night
- Deluxe Room: $350-500 per night
- Suite: $550-900 per night

Rates are subject to change and do not include taxes and fees.

### Resort Fees
A resort fee of $35 per night per night applies and includes WiFi, fitness center access, and pool access.

### Parking Fees
$15 per night

### Pet Fees
$50 per stay (non-refundable)

### Extra Guest Charges
Additional guests beyond standard occupancy: $25 per person per night (children under 12 stay free)

### Address & Directions
1052 Central Avenue, Phoenix, AZ 85002

### Airport Transportation
Airport shuttle service is not provided. Taxi and rideshare services are readily available.

### Public Transportation
The hotel is conveniently located near public transportation options. Please contact the front desk for detailed directions and schedules.

### Nearby Attractions
Luxury accommodations with stunning city views Our concierge can provide recommendations and assistance with booking local tours and attractions.

## Services

Room service is not available. However, many delivery options are available in the area.

Laundry services can be arranged through the front desk with local providers.

### Concierge Services
Front desk staff are happy to provide local recommendations and assistance.

### Wake-up Calls
Automated wake-up calls can be arranged through your in-room phone or by contacting the front desk.

### Smoking Policy
Sunset Peak Lodge is a non-smoking property. Smoking is permitted in designated outdoor areas only. A cleaning fee of $250 applies to any smoking in guest rooms.

### Age Requirements
Guests must be at least 18 years of age to check in.

### ID Requirements
A valid government-issued photo ID and credit card are required at check-in.

### Damage Policy
Guests are responsible for any damage to hotel property. Charges for damages will be applied to the credit card on file.

### Quiet Hours
Quiet hours are observed from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. We ask all guests to be respectful of others during these hours.

## WiFi & Technology

### WiFi Availability
Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms and public areas.

### Network Access
Network name and password are provided at check-in and are also available in your guest room.

### Smart TV
All rooms feature smart TVs with access to premium channels and streaming capabilities.

### Charging Ports
Rooms are equipped with USB charging ports and standard electrical outlets.

Cribs are available at no charge (subject to availability). Rollaway beds are available for $25 per night.

### Connecting Rooms
Connecting rooms are available and can be requested at the time of booking (subject to availability).

### Floor Preferences
High floor and low floor preferences can be requested but cannot be guaranteed. We will do our best to accommodate your preference.

### Hypoallergenic Rooms
Hypoallergenic rooms with special cleaning protocols are available upon request. Please notify us at the time of booking.

## Additional Information

For any questions or special requests, please contact us at:
- Phone: +1-602-555-0128
- Email: phoenix2@anycompany.com

# Sunset Peak Lodge

## Hotel Overview
Sunset Peak Lodge is located in Phoenix, AZ, USA. Luxury accommodations with stunning city views

**Guest Rating:** 4.5/5.0
**Total Rooms:** 290

## Contact Information
**Address:** 1052 Central Avenue, Phoenix, AZ 85002
**Phone:** +1-602-555-0128
**Email:** phoenix2@anycompany.com

## Check-in & Check-out

### Check-in Time
Standard check-in time is 3:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to availability and may be requested at the time of booking or by contacting the hotel directly.

### Check-out Time
Standard check-out time is 11:00 AM. Late check-out until 2:00 PM may be available for an additional fee of $50, subject to availability.

### Express Check-out
Express check-out is available. Guests can review and approve their bill the night before departure and simply drop off their room keys at the front desk or in the express check-out box.

## Reservations & Cancellations

### Making a Reservation
Reservations can be made through:
- Our website: www.anycompany.com
- Phone: +1-602-555-0128
- Email: phoenix2@anycompany.com
- Mobile app: AnyCompany Hotels

### Cancellation Policy
Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours prior to arrival to avoid a one-night room charge. Cancellations for group bookings (10+ rooms) require 72 hours notice.

### Modification Policy
Reservations can be modified up to 24 hours before arrival at no charge. Changes to dates are subject to availability and rate differences may apply.

### Deposit Requirements
A valid credit card is required at the time of booking. A deposit equal to one night's room rate plus tax will be charged at booking for reservations made within 7 days of arrival.

### Payment Methods
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and Diners Club. Cash and debit cards are also accepted.

## Room Information

### Room Types Available
- **Standard Room:** Comfortable accommodations with essential amenities ($200-350 per night)
- **Deluxe Room:** Enhanced space and upgraded amenities ($350-500 per night)
- **Suite:** Spacious suite with separate living area ($550-900 per night)

### Bed Configurations
- King bed
- Two Queen beds
- Accessible rooms with King bed

### Maximum Occupancy
- Standard/Deluxe Rooms: Up to 4 guests
- Suites: Up to 6 guests

### In-Room Amenities
All rooms include:
- Complimentary high-speed WiFi
- Flat-screen TV with premium channels
- Coffee maker with complimentary coffee and tea
- Mini-refrigerator
- In-room safe
- Iron and ironing board
- Hair dryer
- Complimentary toiletries
- Climate control

### Accessibility Features
Accessible rooms are available featuring:
- Roll-in showers or accessible tubs
- Grab bars
- Lowered fixtures
- Visual alert systems
- Accessible door hardware

## Hotel Amenities

- Outdoor Swimming Pool
- Full-Service Spa
- 24-Hour Fitness Center
- Complimentary High-Speed Wifi
- On-Site Restaurant
- Lounge Bar

### Pool
Our outdoor pool is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Pool towels are provided.

### Fitness Center
Our 24-hour fitness center is equipped with cardio machines, free weights, and strength training equipment.

### Restaurant & Bar
Our on-site restaurant serves breakfast (6:30 AM - 10:30 AM), lunch (11:30 AM - 2:30 PM), and dinner (5:30 PM - 10:00 PM). The bar is open from 4:00 PM to midnight.

### Business Center
Business center facilities are not available at this property.

### Parking
Parking is available for $15 per night. Self-parking is available in our parking facility.

### Pet Policy
Pets are welcome! We charge a non-refundable pet fee of $50 per stay. Maximum of 2 pets per room, with a weight limit of 50 lbs per pet. Service animals are always welcome at no charge.

## Pricing & Fees

### Room Rates
Room rates vary by season and availability:
- Standard Room: $200-350 per night
- Deluxe Room: $350-500 per night
- Suite: $550-900 per night

Rates are subject to change and do not include taxes and fees.

### Resort Fees
A resort fee of $35 per night per night applies and includes WiFi, fitness center access, and pool access.

### Parking Fees
$15 per night

### Pet Fees
$50 per stay (non-refundable)

### Extra Guest Charges
Additional guests beyond standard occupancy: $25 per person per night (children under 12 stay free)

## Location & Transportation

### Address & Directions
1052 Central Avenue, Phoenix, AZ 85002

### Airport Transportation
Airport shuttle service is not provided. Taxi and rideshare services are readily available.

### Public Transportation
The hotel is conveniently located near public transportation options. Please contact the front desk for detailed directions and schedules.

### Nearby Attractions
Luxury accommodations with stunning city views Our concierge can provide recommendations and assistance with booking local tours and attractions.

## Services

### Room Service
Room service is not available. However, many delivery options are available in the area.

### Housekeeping
Daily housekeeping service is provided. Additional cleaning services can be requested at the front desk.

### Laundry Services
Laundry services can be arranged through the front desk with local providers.

### Concierge Services
Front desk staff are happy to provide local recommendations and assistance.

### Wake-up Calls
Automated wake-up calls can be arranged through your in-room phone or by contacting the front desk.

## Policies

### Smoking Policy
Sunset Peak Lodge is a non-smoking property. Smoking is permitted in designated outdoor areas only. A cleaning fee of $250 applies to any smoking in guest rooms.

### Age Requirements
Guests must be at least 18 years of age to check in.

### ID Requirements
A valid government-issued photo ID and credit card are required at check-in.

### Damage Policy
Guests are responsible for any damage to hotel property. Charges for damages will be applied to the credit card on file.

### Quiet Hours
Quiet hours are observed from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. We ask all guests to be respectful of others during these hours.

## WiFi & Technology

### WiFi Availability
Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms and public areas.

### Network Access
Network name and password are provided at check-in and are also available in your guest room.

### Smart TV
All rooms feature smart TVs with access to premium channels and streaming capabilities.

### Charging Ports
Rooms are equipped with USB charging ports and standard electrical outlets.

## Special Requests

### Cribs & Rollaway Beds
Cribs are available at no charge (subject to availability). Rollaway beds are available for $25 per night.

### Connecting Rooms
Connecting rooms are available and can be requested at the time of booking (subject to availability).

### Floor Preferences
High floor and low floor preferences can be requested but cannot be guaranteed. We will do our best to accommodate your preference.

### Hypoallergenic Rooms
Hypoallergenic rooms with special cleaning protocols are available upon request. Please notify us at the time of booking.

## Additional Information

For any questions or special requests, please contact us at:
- Phone: +1-602-555-0128
- Email: phoenix2@anycompany.com

We look forward to welcoming you to Sunset Peak Lodge!

A valid credit card is required at the time of booking. A deposit equal to one night's room rate plus tax will be charged at booking for reservations made within 7 days of arrival.

### Payment Methods
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and Diners Club. Cash and debit cards are also accepted.

## Room Information

### Room Types Available
- **Standard Room:** Comfortable accommodations with essential amenities ($200-350 per night)
- **Deluxe Room:** Enhanced space and upgraded amenities ($350-500 per night)
- **Suite:** Spacious suite with separate living area ($550-900 per night)

### Bed Configurations
- King bed
- Two Queen beds
- Accessible rooms with King bed

### Maximum Occupancy
- Standard/Deluxe Rooms: Up to 4 guests
- Suites: Up to 6 guests

### In-Room Amenities
All rooms include:
- Complimentary high-speed WiFi
- Flat-screen TV with premium channels
- Coffee maker with complimentary coffee and tea
- Mini-refrigerator
- In-room safe
- Iron and ironing board
- Hair dryer
- Complimentary toiletries
- Climate control

### Accessibility Features
Accessible rooms are available featuring:
- Roll-in showers or accessible tubs
- Grab bars
- Lowered fixtures
- Visual alert systems
- Accessible door hardware

## Hotel Amenities

- Complimentary High-Speed Wifi
- 24-Hour Fitness Center
- Outdoor Swimming Pool
- On-Site Restaurant
- Concierge Services

### Pool
Our outdoor pool is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Pool towels are provided.

### Fitness Center
Our 24-hour fitness center is equipped with cardio machines, free weights, and strength training equipment.

### Restaurant & Bar
Our on-site restaurant serves breakfast (6:30 AM - 10:30 AM), lunch (11:30 AM - 2:30 PM), and dinner (5:30 PM - 10:00 PM). The bar is open from 4:00 PM to midnight.

### Business Center
Business center facilities are not available at this property.

### Parking
Parking is available for $15 per night. Self-parking is available in our parking facility.

### Pet Policy
Pets are welcome! We charge a non-refundable pet fee of $50 per stay. Maximum of 2 pets per room, with a weight limit of 50 lbs per pet. Service animals are always welcome at no charge.

## Pricing & Fees

### Room Rates
Room rates vary by season and availability:
- Standard Room: $200-350 per night
- Deluxe Room: $350-500 per night
- Suite: $550-900 per night

Rates are subject to change and do not include taxes and fees.

### Resort Fees
A resort fee of $35 per night per night applies and includes WiFi, fitness center access, and pool access.

### Parking Fees
$15 per night

### Pet Fees
$50 per stay (non-refundable)

### Extra Guest Charges
Additional guests beyond standard occupancy: $25 per person per night (children under 12 stay free)

## Location & Transportation

### Address & Directions
Avenida 282, Ensenada, Baja California 77282

### Airport Transportation
Airport shuttle service is not provided. Taxi and rideshare services are readily available.

### Public Transportation
The hotel is conveniently located near public transportation options. Please contact the front desk for detailed directions and schedules.

### Nearby Attractions
Contemporary hotel perfect for business and leisure Our concierge can provide recommendations and assistance with booking local tours and attractions.

## Services

### Room Service
Room service is not available. However, many delivery options are available in the area.

### Housekeeping
Daily housekeeping service is provided. Additional cleaning services can be requested at the front desk.

### Laundry Services
Laundry services can be arranged through the front desk with local providers.

### Concierge Services
Our concierge team is available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM to assist with restaurant reservations, tour bookings, and local recommendations.

### Wake-up Calls
Automated wake-up calls can be arranged through your in-room phone or by contacting the front desk.

## Policies

### Smoking Policy
Blowhole Coastal Resort is a non-smoking property. Smoking is permitted in designated outdoor areas only. A cleaning fee of $250 applies to any smoking in guest rooms.

### Age Requirements
Guests must be at least 18 years of age to check in.

### ID Requirements
A valid government-issued photo ID and credit card are required at check-in.

### Damage Policy
Guests are responsible for any damage to hotel property. Charges for damages will be applied to the credit card on file.

### Quiet Hours
Quiet hours are observed from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. We ask all guests to be respectful of others during these hours.

## WiFi & Technology

### WiFi Availability
Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms and public areas.

### Network Access
Network name and password are provided at check-in and are also available in your guest room.

### Smart TV
All rooms feature smart TVs with access to premium channels and streaming capabilities.

### Charging Ports
Rooms are equipped with USB charging ports and standard electrical outlets.

## Special Requests

### Cribs & Rollaway Beds
Cribs are available at no charge (subject to availability). Rollaway beds are available for $25 per night.

### Connecting Rooms
Connecting rooms are available and can be requested at the time of booking (subject to availability).

### Floor Preferences
High floor and low floor preferences can be requested but cannot be guaranteed. We will do our best to accommodate your preference.

### Hypoallergenic Rooms
Hypoallergenic rooms with special cleaning protocols are available upon request. Please notify us at the time of booking.

## Additional Information

For any questions or special requests, please contact us at:
- Phone: +52-646-555-0270
- Email: ensenada2@anycompany.com

# Sunset Peak Lodge

## Hotel Overview
Sunset Peak Lodge is located in Phoenix, AZ, USA. Luxury accommodations with stunning city views

**Guest Rating:** 4.5/5.0
**Total Rooms:** 290

## Contact Information
**Address:** 1052 Central Avenue, Phoenix, AZ 85002
**Phone:** +1-602-555-0128
**Email:** phoenix2@anycompany.com

## Check-in & Check-out

### Check-in Time
Standard check-in time is 3:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to availability and may be requested at the time of booking or by contacting the hotel directly.

### Check-out Time
Standard check-out time is 11:00 AM. Late check-out until 2:00 PM may be available for an additional fee of $50, subject to availability.

### Express Check-out
Express check-out is available. Guests can review and approve their bill the night before departure and simply drop off their room keys at the front desk or in the express check-out box.

## Reservations & Cancellations

### Making a Reservation
Reservations can be made through:
- Our website: www.anycompany.com
- Phone: +1-602-555-0128
- Email: phoenix2@anycompany.com
- Mobile app: AnyCompany Hotels

### Cancellation Policy
Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours prior to arrival to avoid a one-night room charge. Cancellations for group bookings (10+ rooms) require 72 hours notice.

### Modification Policy
Reservations can be modified up to 24 hours before arrival at no charge. Changes to dates are subject to availability and rate differences may apply.

### Deposit Requirements
A valid credit card is required at the time of booking. A deposit equal to one night's room rate plus tax will be charged at booking for reservations made within 7 days of arrival.

### Payment Methods
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and Diners Club. Cash and debit cards are also accepted.

## Room Information

### Room Types Available
- **Standard Room:** Comfortable accommodations with essential amenities ($200-350 per night)
- **Deluxe Room:** Enhanced space and upgraded amenities ($350-500 per night)
- **Suite:** Spacious suite with separate living area ($550-900 per night)

### Bed Configurations
- King bed
- Two Queen beds
- Accessible rooms with King bed

### Maximum Occupancy
- Standard/Deluxe Rooms: Up to 4 guests
- Suites: Up to 6 guests

### In-Room Amenities
All rooms include:
- Complimentary high-speed WiFi
- Flat-screen TV with premium channels
- Coffee maker with complimentary coffee and tea
- Mini-refrigerator
- In-room safe
- Iron and ironing board
- Hair dryer
- Complimentary toiletries
- Climate control

### Accessibility Features
Accessible rooms are available featuring:
- Roll-in showers or accessible tubs
- Grab bars
- Lowered fixtures
- Visual alert systems
- Accessible door hardware

## Hotel Amenities

- Outdoor Swimming Pool
- Full-Service Spa
- 24-Hour Fitness Center
- Complimentary High-Speed Wifi
- On-Site Restaurant
- Lounge Bar

### Pool
Our outdoor pool is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Pool towels are provided.

### Fitness Center
Our 24-hour fitness center is equipped with cardio machines, free weights, and strength training equipment.

### Restaurant & Bar
Our on-site restaurant serves breakfast (6:30 AM - 10:30 AM), lunch (11:30 AM - 2:30 PM), and dinner (5:30 PM - 10:00 PM). The bar is open from 4:00 PM to midnight.

### Business Center
Business center facilities are not available at this property.

### Parking
Parking is available for $15 per night. Self-parking is available in our parking facility.

### Pet Policy
Pets are welcome! We charge a non-refundable pet fee of $50 per stay. Maximum of 2 pets per room, with a weight limit of 50 lbs per pet. Service animals are always welcome at no charge.

## Pricing & Fees

### Room Rates
Room rates vary by season and availability:
- Standard Room: $200-350 per night
- Deluxe Room: $350-500 per night
- Suite: $550-900 per night

Rates are subject to change and do not include taxes and fees.

### Resort Fees
A resort fee of $35 per night per night applies and includes WiFi, fitness center access, and pool access.

### Parking Fees
$15 per night

### Pet Fees
$50 per stay (non-refundable)

### Extra Guest Charges
Additional guests beyond standard occupancy: $25 per person per night (children under 12 stay free)

## Location & Transportation

### Address & Directions
1052 Central Avenue, Phoenix, AZ 85002

### Airport Transportation
Airport shuttle service is not provided. Taxi and rideshare services are readily available.

### Public Transportation
The hotel is conveniently located near public transportation options. Please contact the front desk for detailed directions and schedules.

### Nearby Attractions
Luxury accommodations with stunning city views Our concierge can provide recommendations and assistance with booking local tours and attractions.

## Services

### Room Service
Room service is not available. However, many delivery options are available in the area.

### Housekeeping
Daily housekeeping service is provided. Additional cleaning services can be requested at the front desk.

### Laundry Services
Laundry services can be arranged through the front desk with local providers.

### Concierge Services
Front desk staff are happy to provide local recommendations and assistance.

### Wake-up Calls
Automated wake-up calls can be arranged through your in-room phone or by contacting the front desk.

## Policies

### Smoking Policy
Sunset Peak Lodge is a non-smoking property. Smoking is permitted in designated outdoor areas only. A cleaning fee of $250 applies to any smoking in guest rooms.

### Age Requirements
Guests must be at least 18 years of age to check in.

### ID Requirements
A valid government-issued photo ID and credit card are required at check-in.

### Damage Policy
Guests are responsible for any damage to hotel property. Charges for damages will be applied to the credit card on file.

### Quiet Hours
Quiet hours are observed from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. We ask all guests to be respectful of others during these hours.

## WiFi & Technology

### WiFi Availability
Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms and public areas.

### Network Access
Network name and password are provided at check-in and are also available in your guest room.

### Smart TV
All rooms feature smart TVs with access to premium channels and streaming capabilities.

### Charging Ports
Rooms are equipped with USB charging ports and standard electrical outlets.

## Special Requests

### Cribs & Rollaway Beds
Cribs are available at no charge (subject to availability). Rollaway beds are available for $25 per night.

### Connecting Rooms
Connecting rooms are available and can be requested at the time of booking (subject to availability).

### Floor Preferences
High floor and low floor preferences can be requested but cannot be guaranteed. We will do our best to accommodate your preference.

### Hypoallergenic Rooms
Hypoallergenic rooms with special cleaning protocols are available upon request. Please notify us at the time of booking.

## Additional Information

For any questions or special requests, please contact us at:
- Phone: +1-602-555-0128
- Email: phoenix2@anycompany.com

We look forward to welcoming you to Sunset Peak Lodge!

## Contact Information
**Address:** Avenida 221, Puebla, Puebla 77221
**Phone:** +52-222-555-0257
**Email:** puebla1@anycompany.com

# Sunset Peak Lodge

## Hotel Overview
Sunset Peak Lodge is located in Phoenix, AZ, USA. Luxury accommodations with stunning city views

**Guest Rating:** 4.5/5.0
**Total Rooms:** 290

## Contact Information
**Address:** 1052 Central Avenue, Phoenix, AZ 85002
**Phone:** +1-602-555-0128
**Email:** phoenix2@anycompany.com

## Check-in & Check-out

### Check-in Time
Standard check-in time is 3:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to availability and may be requested at the time of booking or by contacting the hotel directly.

### Check-out Time
Standard check-out time is 11:00 AM. Late check-out until 2:00 PM may be available for an additional fee of $50, subject to availability.

### Express Check-out
Express check-out is available. Guests can review and approve their bill the night before departure and simply drop off their room keys at the front desk or in the express check-out box.

## Reservations & Cancellations

### Making a Reservation
Reservations can be made through:
- Our website: www.anycompany.com
- Phone: +1-602-555-0128
- Email: phoenix2@anycompany.com
- Mobile app: AnyCompany Hotels

### Cancellation Policy
Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours prior to arrival to avoid a one-night room charge. Cancellations for group bookings (10+ rooms) require 72 hours notice.

### Modification Policy
Reservations can be modified up to 24 hours before arrival at no charge. Changes to dates are subject to availability and rate differences may apply.

### Deposit Requirements
